messages:
sanjay_csm: Hey all — kicking off onboarding for Northstar Labs. Goal: 30/60/90 enablement + production readiness for early pilot. Proposed kickoff meeting Wed 2026-04-14 10:00 PT. Can we confirm stakeholders and surface any renewal / procurement risks now?

maria_cs: I can lead enablement and customer success ops — will own playbooks + training schedule.

derek_pm: I’ll own implementation milestones and success criteria. Alex will be our technical lead on the integration side.

alex_se: Got it. Key infra items for Northstar: SCIM + SSO, IP allowlist, and a sandbox GPU pool for model tests. Can we get their SRE contact?

sanjay_csm: Contact is integrations@northstarlabs.com (cc procurement@northstarlabs.com). Procurement flagged a security questionnaire that could delay SOW signing — estimated 10 business days. That’s a potential renewal risk if pilots slip.

eva_engineer: For model validation I need: sample dataset (<=50k tokens), a couple of seed prompts, and expected pass/fail checks. Also will spin up a quantized variant test.

alex_se: Noted. For IP allowlist, they need us to whitelist: 34.82.123.45/32. For quick access request paste this:```
Request:
- Email: integrations@northstarlabs.com
- Resource: sandbox-gpu-1
- IP: 34.82.123.45/32
```

onboarding_bot: /onboard create "Northstar Labs" --owner sanjay_csm --start 2026-04-14 --kickoff-meeting 2026-04-14T17:00Z

maria_cs: Proposed success criteria (draft):
- Day 30: basic integration + sample inference run (<=500ms median latency in sandbox), enablement session completed for 3 PM contacts.
- Day 60: pilot metrics collection, cost-per-1k-token baseline, and at least one app-level QA test passing.
- Day 90: production rollback policy in place, SLA expectations agreed, and procurement contract executed.

derek_pm: Add quality guardrails: automated evals with <5% semantic regression vs baseline for top-10 prompts. If exceeded, trigger canary rollback.

sanjay_csm: Risk log (quick):
- Procurement delay (~10bd) — mitigation: start technical onboarding before SOW finalization with limited data.
- Security review items around KMS/HSM — mitigation: provide architecture doc and HVAA checklist.
- Usage mismatch risk — mitigation: set burst limits and alerting during pilot.

eva_engineer: Will prepare a short test harness and include example eval scripts. ETA: Fri 2026-04-17.

alex_se: I’ll request firewall & SCIM items with infra: ticket INF-8472. Owners: alex_se, platform-oncall.

maria_cs: Enablement plan — I'll schedule three 60-min sessions: Admin walkthorugh, Dev integration, and Ops/Monitoring. Dates tentative: 4/20, 4/22, 4/28.

sanjay_csm: Action items:
- sanjay_csm: Confirm kickoff invite + stakeholder list by EOD today.
- maria_cs: Create enablement calendar and share recordings.
- alex_se: Open infra ticket and confirm sandbox creds by 4/16.
- eva_engineer: Drop test harness + prompts by 4/17.

derek_pm: I'll produce the 30/60/90 success checklist doc and post in GS drive (link to follow).

sanjay_csm: OK — if no objections I’ll lock kickoff time and send invites. Please react with :thumbsup: once you’ve picked up action items.

alex_se: :thumbsup:

eva_engineer: :thumbsup:

maria_cs: :thumbsup:

derek_pm: :thumbsup:
